text: The comparison covers four project-level lists, not the entire national budget.
Program, region, office, and dataset rankings describe overlapping dimensions and must not be added together.
Regions and offices are reproduced from source labels and are not determinations of political sponsorship or responsibility.
A House-only row can reflect naming, grouping, or scope differences and is not proof of an insertion or wrongdoing.
A concentration is a review priority, not evidence that an allocation is unfair, improper, or politically motivated.
Ambiguous and scope-review rows remain quarantined and are not promoted as findings.
The release does not establish Senate, bicameral, enacted GAA, release, payment, implementation, or outcome stages.
Document amounts are proposed authority, not releases, payments, final costs, or outcomes.
